# Redline Site Services

> Licensed septic company based in Monroe, NC, serving Union, Cabarrus, Mecklenburg, and Anson counties and the greater Charlotte, NC area. Services include septic tank pumping, repair, installation, replacement, inspections, cleaning, drain field repair, drainage excavation, and porta-john rental. NC General Contractor's License #109441.
